Home | Pimlico Docs
Pimlico is the world's most advanced ERC-4337 account abstraction infrastructure platform. Pimlico provides a suite of tools and services to help you build, deploy, and manage smart accounts on Ethereum and other EVM-compatible chains.
Get startedGo to Dashboard

Sponsor gas →

Use the verifying paymaster to submit a gasless transaction.

Batch multiple transactions →

Combine actions like approve + swap into a single user operation.

Pay gas in any token →

Let users pay gas in any token via our ERC-20 paymaster.

Social logins →

Onboard users with passkeys, Privy, Dynamic, Magic, Web3Auth, and more.
